sections.indications:
This Ark is beneficial in: 

 Aamvata – rheumatoid arthritis-like condition 
 Vatarakta – gout 
 Prameha (Diabetes Mellitus) 
 Rakta Pitta – bleeding disorders 
 Jeerna Jwara – chronic fever 
 Pittaj Jwara – fever due to Pitta aggravation 
 Heat-related blood disorders 
 General metabolic imbalance 


 Clinical Significance 
 Giloy Ark is particularly useful in chronic and recurring diseases where Ama accumulation plays a central role. It improves digestion, enhances metabolism, and gradually eliminates toxins from the body. In diabetes (Madhumeha), it helps regulate blood sugar metabolism. The classical reference mentions that patients can take small doses mixed with water whenever thirsty, which helps reduce sugar levels in urine over time. In chronic fevers, especially those with a relapsing pattern, Giloy Ark acts as a gentle yet effective antipyretic without weakening the patient. Its action on blood purification makes it beneficial in inflammatory and heat-related conditions. 

 Modern Perspective 
 Tinospora cordifolia contains bioactive compounds such as: 

 Tinosporin 
 Berberine-like alkaloids 
 Glycosides 
 Polysaccharides 

 These contribute to: 

 Immunomodulatory activity 
 Anti-inflammatory effects 
 Antipyretic action 
 Blood sugar regulation 

 The Ark form enhances absorption and reduces digestive load, making it suitable for long-term use.
sections.precautions:
Use under supervision in severe metabolic disorders 
 Maintain proper diet (Pathya) for better results 
 Avoid excessive dosage 


 Conclusion 
 Giloy Ark, prepared from Tinospora cordifolia, is a powerful yet gentle Ayurvedic distillate known for its role in detoxification, immune support, and metabolic regulation. It is highly effective in chronic fever, diabetes, inflammatory disorders, and blood-related conditions. With its broad-spectrum action and safety profile, it continues to be an important classical formulation for restoring balance and vitality in the body.

Giloy Ark 
 Introduction 
 Giloy Ark is a classical Ayurvedic distillate prepared from fresh stems of Giloy (Tinospora cordifolia), commonly known in English as Heart-leaved Moonseed or Guduchi. This herb is one of the most revered Rasayana (rejuvenative) drugs in Ayurveda, widely known for its immunomodulatory, antipyretic, and detoxifying properties. The Ark form is a light, aqueous distillation that captures the subtle active components of the herb, making it easy to digest and rapidly absorbable. Giloy Ark is especially beneficial in conditions associated with Ama (toxins), chronic fever, metabolic disorders, and inflammatory conditions affecting the blood and joints. Traditionally, it is considered a Tridosha-balancing formulation with special efficacy in Pitta and Vata disorders, particularly where heat, inflammation, and toxicity are involved. 

 Ingredients 
 
 Giloy (Guduchi / Heart-leaved Moonseed) (Tinospora cordifolia) – 2.5 seer (~2.3 kg, fresh stem) 
 Water – 20 seer (~18.5–19 liters) 
 

 Method of Preparation 
 Fresh green stems of Giloy are cut into small pieces and coarsely crushed using a mortar (Imam Dasta or wooden pestle). This helps in releasing the internal active constituents. The crushed material is soaked overnight in water to initiate extraction and soften the fibers. On the following morning, the soaked mixture is transferred into a Nadika Yantra (distillation apparatus / Bhapka). The mixture is subjected to controlled heating, and approximately 20 bottles of Ark are collected through distillation. The obtained distillate is filtered and stored in clean, airtight bottles for therapeutic use. 

 Dosage and Anupan 
 
 2 to 5 tola (~24 ml to 60 ml) 
 Administered morning and evening 
 Can be taken alone or mixed with equal quantity of water 
 

 Properties 
 Rasa (Taste) 
 
 Tikta (Bitter) 
 Kashaya (Astringent) 
 

 Guna (Qualities) 
 
 Laghu (Light) 
 Snigdha (Slightly unctuous) 
 

 Virya (Potency) 
 
 Ushna (Heating, though overall balancing) 
 

 Vipaka (Post-digestive effect) 
 
 Madhura (Sweet) 
 

 Dosha Effect 
 
 Pacifies Pitta dosha 
 Balances Kapha dosha 
 Regulates Kapha dosha 
 

 Therapeutic Actions 
 Giloy Ark is known for the following Ayurvedic actions: 
 
 Jwaraghna – reduces fever 
 Rasayana – rejuvenative 
 Aam Pachaka – digests toxins 
 Raktashodhaka – purifies blood 
 Pramehaghna – beneficial in metabolic disorders 
 Vatarakta Hara – useful in gout and inflammatory joint disorders 
 Dahashamaka – relieves burning sensation 
 

 Indications 
 This Ark is beneficial in: 
 
 Aamvata – rheumatoid arthritis-like condition 
 Vatarakta – gout 
 Prameha (Diabetes Mellitus) 
 Rakta Pitta – bleeding disorders 
 Jeerna Jwara – chronic fever

It improves digestion, enhances metabolism, and gradually eliminates toxins from the body. In diabetes (Madhumeha), it helps regulate blood sugar metabolism. The classical reference mentions that patients can take small doses mixed with water whenever thirsty, which helps reduce sugar levels in urine over time. In chronic fevers, especially those with a relapsing pattern, Giloy Ark acts as a gentle yet effective antipyretic without weakening the patient. Its action on blood purification makes it beneficial in inflammatory and heat-related conditions. 

 Modern Perspective 
 Tinospora cordifolia contains bioactive compounds such as: 
 
 Tinosporin 
 Berberine-like alkaloids 
 Glycosides 
 Polysaccharides 
 
 These contribute to: 
 
 Immunomodulatory activity 
 Anti-inflammatory effects 
 Antipyretic action 
 Blood sugar regulation 
 
 The Ark form enhances absorption and reduces digestive load, making it suitable for long-term use. 

 Precautions 
 
 Use under supervision in severe metabolic disorders 
 Maintain proper diet (Pathya) for better results 
 Avoid excessive dosage

 Giloy Ark, prepared from Tinospora cordifolia, is a powerful yet gentle Ayurvedic distillate known for its role in detoxification, immune support, and metabolic regulation. It is highly effective in chronic fever, diabetes, inflammatory disorders, and blood-related conditions. With its broad-spectrum action and safety profile, it continues to be an important classical formulation for restoring balance and vitality in the body.
